name: Dealings with known facilitators or persons on investigative watch lists
description: Customer transacts, including in small amounts, with persons identified in public or law-enforcement material as facilitators or subjects of prior reports.
fp: Low-value contact may be innocent, such as family or community links or name matches.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters
FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
FATF, Ethnically or Racially Motivated Terrorism Financing (2021)

links.name: Connections to known facilitators or recruiters
links.ctx: Customer transacts with parties identified in public or law enforcement material as facilitators of travel.
links.fp: Social contacts and shared community groups cause innocent links.

links.name: Small transfers to or from a person on a watch or investigative list
links.ctx: Low-value payments with parties linked to previously reported subjects or to persons arrested in connection with violent extremism.
links.fp: Family, employment or community connections to a subject can be innocent.
